messages:
anya: FYI — support ticket #9874: two users saw ~double token usage after transient 502 + client retry. Looks like optimistic quota reservation + retry path not deduping.

samir: repro steps?

anya: steps pasted from user: 1) call /v1/generate w/ idempotency absent; 2) 502 after ~120ms; 3) client retries immediately; 4) both responses returned and charged. They were on per-key quota and burst=enabled.

maria: oof. Is this only when optimistic-reserve is on? We do a temporary reservation at request accept to avoid soft-throttling.

elena: yes. reservation window is 30s by default. If client retries before the first flow completes, we've already reserved and then the retry triggers another reserve -> double count unless dedupe.

samir: two orthogonal fixes: 1) strengthen idempotency guidance in SDKs (ensure clients persist idempotency-key across retries), 2) server-side conservative dedupe for small time-window using a request fingerprint.

maria: +1. For server fingerprint I sketched: ```python
fingerprint = sha256(f"{org_id}|{api_key}|{model}|{truncate(prompt,256)}|{content_hash}")
# store with TTL = reservation_window + 5s
```
Would treat same fingerprint seen in TTL as duplicate and return cached charge/result or at least avoid reserving again.

elena: edge cases: streaming requests and tool-calls — fingerprinting whole prompt may be expensive. Maybe use prefix hash + token_count + model + kw args.

anya: can we rely on client idempotency? many of our customers use third-party proxies that generate new keys on each retry.

samir: so server guard is necessary. But careful: if two distinct requests legitimately differ but collide on fingerprint you could suppress a valid second request. Make fingerprint conservative enough (include nonce-like fields) and only dedupe within a short window. Also prefer returning 409 + diagnostic if duplicate detected.

billing-bot: Alert: possible duplicate charge cluster detected for org:org_0xabc in the last 1h (delta=+2.1% over baseline).

maria: UX question: Console should show 'optimistic reserve' hits separately in quota / billing dashboard and expose dedupe events so support can explain. Otherwise customers see weird token jumps.

elena: agree. Add a 'dedupe' tag to ingestion events and in per-route dashboard surface 'reservations prevented' metric. Also add rollout flag to toggle fingerprint dedupe per-org.

samir: action items:
- [ ] infra: implement fingerprint reserve guard w/ configurable window (samir)
- [ ] sdk: add idempotency examples + helper to persist key across retries (maria)
- [ ] product: console metric + UI change for reserve/dedupe (elena)
- [ ] support: add KB explaining retry best practices (anya)

anya: thanks — will open JIRA and link here.

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/opt-reserve-dedupe -> staging at 1825554600

anya: cool, keep me posted, especially any telemetry I can use to confirm duplicates resolved.
